checked_at.description: When the check ran, in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. A cached answer keeps the time of its own check, up to an hour old.

final_url.description: It is the last hop's URL at final_answer and request_failed. null at location_invalid and location_too_long. At every other stop it is the next URL, which was not requested. That is the start URL when hops is [].

stop_reason.description: It says why the chain stopped. It is final_answer, request_limit, loop, location_invalid, location_too_long, scheme_not_followed, port_not_allowed, ip_address_not_followed, host_not_public, quota_exhausted, deadline or request_failed.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before the server sends that request again. Present only when stop_reason is quota_exhausted.

invalid_location.description: Present only at location_invalid. It holds the raw Location text. A value longer than 500 code points is cut there. Read it as untrusted text.

total_invalid_location_length.description: Present only when invalid_location was cut. It gives the whole length in code points.

https_downgrade.description: true when an http URL comes right after an https one. The final_url that was not requested counts too.

url.description: It is the URL of the request, without user name, password and fragment.

status_code.description: Present when the request got an answer.

error.description: Present instead of status_code when the request got no answer. It is resolve_failed, connect_failed, timeout, tls_failed, address_not_globally_reachable or other.

had_userinfo.description: Present only when the target that led here carried a user name or a password, which was not sent. It is then true.

refresh.description: Present only when the answer had a Refresh header. It holds the raw value, which is not followed. A value longer than 500 code points is cut there.

total_refresh_length.description: Present only when refresh was cut. It gives the whole length in code points.

hops.description: It lists each request sent, in order. [] when no request was sent.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
